header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner, nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed with the prayer that respondents be directed to release and transfer pension of the petitioner. After notice, the respondents filed their comments; however, perusal of compliance report submitted by Section Officer/ Secretary (PPCDC) for Chairman (PPCDC), Finance Department, Government of Sindh, reflects that case of the petitioner has been finalized on 07-11-2024 for family pension, therefore, this petition has become infructuous; hence same is hereby disposed of JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
